name: Fujima Nagisa
source:
A second-year student at Seishin Academy and a member of the track and field team. She is a very bright and active tanned girl. She has a [url=/c133967]boyfriend[/url] on the baseball team whom she has just started dating. And before they get to know each other deeply, she has to receive sexual guidance.
